pages.text: Breeding animals in Novus is vanilla — hold their food, two at a time, hearts and a calf. The one convenience worth knowing is $(italic)Quark's$() $(bold)Feeding Trough$().
pages.title: Keeping Animals

pages.text: $(bold)Feeding Trough.$() Fill it with the right food — wheat, seeds, carrots, whatever the animal eats — and pen your animals near it. They walk up, eat on their own, and breed without you standing there with a fistful of wheat.$(br2)$(li)Its reach is about $(bold)10 blocks$().$(li)It paces itself, and won't keep breeding a pen that's already crowded — it eases off once a few dozen animals are nearby.$(br2)The early answer to a meat or leather farm: build the pen, fill the trough, come back to a crowd.
pages.title: Feeding Trough
